lines.text: Her name was Mia. She was sixteen. A bat, a dead phone...

lines.text: and a mom who said she'd be right back.

lines.text: You slow me down, I leave you.

music.title: Last Light - Mia
music.style: Cinematic zombie drama underscore. Opens tense and sparse with a nervous pulse and scraping textures, a sudden hit for a confrontation, then a fragile melancholic piano and soft strings for a moment of trust, before a slow ominous build of low brass and pounding drums that ends on a menacing swell. Instrumental only, no vocals, mixed to sit under dialogue.
